title: Operations workshop lift
summary: Raise the armoured operations van to inspect its connected drivetrain and chassis.
notes: Use the two-post workshop lift to raise, stop and lower the van on four chassis support pads.
Inspect the engine, gearbox, driveshaft, rear differential and hub-connected axles from underneath.
The lift stops lowering when someone enters the bay; travel requires the van to be fully lowered.
